description: Three models: yolo3d-pick (vision object picking), torque-features (on-robot proprioceptive torque/force sensing), and content:classifier (solid/liquid/empty from the torque cascade).

models.short_description: Vision object picker: configure a YOLO class and detect / pick / pick_place via do_command.
On-robot torque sampling + pose-normalized force/weight + FFT features via do_command.
Predicts solid / liquid / empty from the proprioceptive torque cascade via do_command.
